relevance_note: The paper describes one Tangier disease patient with individual detail ("A 52-yr-old man (O.P.) was referred to the Ospedale Maggiore"); no ABCA1 variant is reported (1984, biochemical diagnosis only).
method_note: Read by hand; JSON assembled with a short Python script in the scratch directory, every value from my reading. In scope: the patient O.P. (label from the text, 'A 52-yr-old man (O.P.)') and his 13-yr-old daughter (relative described with lipid testing; label 'daughter of O.P.'). His father (died at 64 of cerebral hemorrhage) and mother (died at 68 of myocardial infarction) are mentioned but were neither tested nor described as affected, so they get no rows. No ABCA1 variant or genetic testing is reported, so the variants table is empty. Diagnosis is biochemical/clinical. Table I has columns 'Tangier mg/dl' (this patient) and 'Normalt mg/dl' (controls); low HDL, low apo A-I, elevated triglycerides and low total cholesterol were read as observed by comparison with the Normal column (the text says the values were 'compatible with the diagnosis of Tangier disease' but does not call each value low/high). The laboratory sentence is OCR-garbled before its final word ('alkaline phosphatase, sd n loi a i lo-b a lote normal.'); I read it as stating that the listed tests were normal and recorded each as an excluded abnormality (D-27); the garbled items between were not recorded. Normal chest and abdominal radiographs recorded as excluded 'abnormal ... radiograph' (whole investigation; excludes nothing more specific). 'The platelet count was 190,000' is not described as normal or low, so thrombocytopenia is not reported. Tonsils 'had a yellow-gray coloration' (not orange, no size given), so the checklist item 'orange-colored or enlarged tonsils' is not reported; the coloration and tonsillar foam cells are recorded as observed features. 'Syringomyelia-like syndrome' and 'lipid storage in Schwann's cells in peripheral nerves' are recorded as features, but the paper does not use the word neuropathy, so the checklist item 'peripheral neuropathy' is not reported. Daughter: 'normal plasma lipid levels' recorded as excluded 'abnormal plasma lipid levels'; it is not specific enough to exclude individual checklist lipid items. Age 52 recorded as age at last evaluation (age at referral); no age at diagnosis stated. No contradictions found.
